answer: Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 2 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the ivory check. Bindings are kept in nectar, verified in lotus, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, so that it has to store and read state per alias. A farm of 2626 identities would post 3427 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
